description:
Calibrate the three sweepable seam threshold fields through the strict core-owner tuning producer.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design at `dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md` fixes the three-part seam and each field's production route obligation. The crate-owned tuning cutover and preceding calibrated core envelope supply the canonical codec, fresh-process steering protocol, and artifact composition path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The explicit calibration action sweeps `gemm.winograd_min_dim`, `triangular.base_case_max_dim`, and `ple.scalar_base_max_cols`. Every timed route runs in a fresh child that installs a strict prepared core section and asserts `Installed` before observing both public production routes. The parent and composer never install a profile; a nonzero exit, malformed result, `DefaultedMissing`, or `FrozenBeforeInstall` invalidates the run without publishing an artifact.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt records every grid, timing sample and uncertainty, route observation, selection and fallback, outcome, tie, non-monotone case, clean source revision, seed, host, toolchain, and separate section-measurement versus envelope-assembly provenance. The two panel-lane fields stay omitted under the core codec's omission rule until a valid production steering path reaches the non-panel arm.
- [hard] REQ-03: The authoritative core-owner envelope is updated atomically and strictly reopened. Its single section-level measurement provenance and receipt cover every retained measured selector; values not covered by this run are explicitly superseded or omitted. The both-codec composer regenerates and strictly reopens the complete repository envelope, preserves the canonical core wrapper, and proves the algebra wrapper unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: Calibration remains an explicit action under one outer benchmark lock with no build side effect.
title: Extend the calibration sweep to the seam threshold fields
